captions.detailed: A classical long achromatic refractor telescope sitting on a wooden equatorial mount. The assembly consists of a long, cream-colored cylindrical telescope tube with a dark blue lens and black end-caps, held securely by two golden ring saddles. The ring saddles connect to an adjustable declination axis, which in turn rotates on a continuous right-ascension axis tilted toward the celestial pole. The entire mechanism is supported by a dark brown, three-legged wooden tripod stand with a central hub.
captions.instruction: Generate a classical long achromatic refractor telescope model on a wooden equatorial mount using CadQuery. The model should feature a long cylindrical optical tube assembly with front/rear end-caps and golden mounting rings, a dual-axis equatorial mount (right ascension and declination axes) made of dark brown and metallic components, and a sturdy three-legged tripod base.
captions.factory: The code constructs the telescope using hierarchical parts and joints. The tripod base is built by combining a central cylinder hub with three angled cylindrical legs. The equatorial mount head uses a tilted box for the polar axis block, which supports a continuous right-ascension shaft. A perpendicular declination block is attached via a revolute joint, carrying a counterweight shaft (cylinder with a thick disk) on one end and two golden ring saddles (hollowed cylinders) on the other. Finally, the main optical tube assembly is modeled as a long cylinder with smaller end-cap cylinders, nested inside the ring saddles.
